# Spray Insulations
Independent insulation planning and credited material imagery.
## Expertise
Insulation project briefs, attic and crawl-space planning, spray foam, Monoglass, HiBar and commercial-work archive context.
## Trust Signals
Images have source credits and factual captions. General enquiries: build@buildershaus.com. Product performance and installer identity require records; photographs alone do not establish them.
## Parent Organization
Industry Army Marketing — Est. May 13, 2015. https://industryarmymarketing.com/
## Service Areas / Coverage
Canadian planning information. Lower Mainland city pages preserve their explicitly assigned contractor contacts. No universal contractor availability is implied.
## Frequently Asked Questions
Where are the material photos? /legacy/ links to the individual pages.
Where are the foam photos? /projects/ retains the photographs and video.
Is HiBar imagery a customer project? The HiBar material page uses credited SOPREMA manufacturer imagery.
Is every page a contractor offer? No; contractor assignments appear explicitly on city pages.
Does an enquiry automatically send? The contact page prepares an email draft; delivery is not verified.
